training_ushcn__conditional_diffusion: Original fit and early-stop losses for all six USHCN diffusion cells. Curves retain every recorded epoch without smoothing; circles mark the logged early-loss minimum under the original selection rule. Loss axes are logarithmic. Seeds repeat optimization on shared data, not independent validation datasets.
